lede: The biggest item this week is Town Council's June 30 first reading of Land Use Code amendments tied to Colorado's Wildfire Resiliency Code — language that will shape how development and fire risk are managed in this box canyon for a long time. That same night the Hospital District board sits down June 25 to dig into mill levy considerations for the new facility, and Planning & Zoning takes an early look at the Shandoka Lot redevelopment proposal. Plenty of summer life filling the gaps: the Oak Street Park SummerSHOW kicks off Thursday, farmers markets Friday, and the Telluride Theatre Muleskinner's Ball fundraiser Saturday at the Sheridan.

notable.stake: First reading of wildfire code amendments sets long-term development and fire-risk rules.
Mill levy discussion directly affects how the hospital district is funded by taxpayers.
Early feedback shapes the major Town-owned Shandoka Lot redevelopment before formal review.
